# Northwest Piano & Voice

> Private, in-home piano and voice lessons in Chicago's northwest suburbs, taught by Michael Krz — a professional opera singer and instructor with over 10 years of teaching experience and music degrees from the University of Iowa and Cincinnati's College-Conservatory of Music.

## Key facts

- Service: private, one-on-one piano and voice (singing) lessons, taught in the student's home
- Rate: $70 per 50-minute lesson; the first lesson is free with no obligation
- Ages: 6 and up, depending on fine motor skills and attention span — children, teens, and adults from beginner to college level
- Styles taught: classical, rock, jazz, pop, and anything the student is interested in
- Recitals: students perform twice a year in front of family and friends
- Contact: call or text 847-840-8571, or email michael@nwpianolessons.com

## Service area (northwest suburbs of Chicago, Illinois)

Arlington Heights, Barrington, Buffalo Grove, Hoffman Estates, Inverness, Kildeer, Long Grove, Mount Prospect, Palatine, Prospect Heights, Rolling Meadows, Schaumburg, South Barrington, Wheeling

## About the instructor

Michael Krz has sung professionally with companies including Opera Santa Barbara, Toledo Opera, San Antonio Opera, Glimmerglass Opera, and the Seattle Opera Young Artists Program, and was a featured soloist at Carnegie Hall with the New York Choral Society. He holds a Master of Music in Voice from the Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music and a Bachelor of Music in Voice from the University of Iowa.
